function spread(...args: number[]): void;
function spread(x: number, y: number) { console.log("spread", x, y); }

function prefixed(x: string, ...args: number[]): void;
function prefixed(x: string, y: number | void) { console.log("prefixed", x, y); }

function both(...args: number[]): void;
function both(...args: number[]) { console.log("both", args); }

function optional(...args: number[]): void;
function optional(x?: number, y?: number) { console.log("optional", x, y); }

function wider(x: number, ...rest: string[]): void;
function wider(...args: (number | string)[]) { console.log("wider", args); }

function tupleRest(...args: [number, ...string[]]): void;
function tupleRest(x: number, y: string, z: string) { console.log("tupleRest", x, y, z); }

function restTail(...args: [string, ...number[]]): void;
function restTail(x: string, ...rest: number[]) { console.log("restTail", x, rest); }

function nullable(...args: number[]): void;
function nullable(x: number | null, y: number) { console.log("nullable", x, y); }

function union(...args: string[]): void;
function union(x: string | number) { console.log("union", x); }

function generic<T>(...args: T[]): T;
function generic(x: number) { return x; }

spread();
spread(1, 2);
prefixed("x");
prefixed("x", 2);
both(1, 2);
optional();
optional(1, 2);
wider(1, "a");
tupleRest(1, "a");
restTail("a", 1, 2);
nullable(1, 2);
union("u");
console.log(generic(3));
